_doc: Music edit for the promo. The raw take is MiniMax Music3 (via crosery-ct advanced_music_generate, instrumental, seed 777, caption audio/caption_v1.txt). analysis/edit.py renders audio/trailer.wav from this file; analysis/analyze.py writes data/audio.json from that WAV.

mix._doc: analysis/mix.py: audio/trailer.wav (music) + sound design (data/sfx.json at the times in data/sfx_events.json), trimmed to the film, picture-synced fade, loudness-normalised. The video is muxed with this file.
